method: Built-in image generation of pigment; opaque motif recolored to earth pigments and blended onto exact prior wall. Generated glow discarded.
visual_review: Inspected full PNG and 512px JPEG: inherited Pepe, wide mouth, heavy-lidded eyes and both five-digit hands preserved; new basket adds no hands. No writing, logos, borders, real people or forbidden symbols observed. Prior marks, rock, framing and lighting retained.
unmet_visual_requirements: Inherited rock texture remains photographic in detail; retained to preserve the existing wall.
limitations: Small stones and basket grain soften in the 512px JPEG.
Local visual and byte checks are observations, not independent certification.
